title: Pebble app is causing 60min+ missed readings (possibly)
symptom: The user reports losing signal for 60+ minutes, usually once a day or every two days, requiring a phone reboot to restore connection. Removing the Pebble app seemed to prevent the issue, but reinstalling it brought back the missed readings.
cause: jamorham suggests it is not the Pebble app exactly but bluetooth resource starvation within Android, where too many paired devices or apps searching for peripherals use up bluetooth slots.
fix: The user reduced the number of watch faces and removed unused paired bluetooth devices, which may have helped; after several days without major signal loss, the issue appears resolved.
evidence_quote: I did just now delete all but a few watch faces. I use xdrip clay 98% of the time. When I take a dex break for a few days I use another face. Let's see if that helps.
